steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Ivy, stick close behind me. Don't let the crowd sweep you away.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Just hold out a minute more. I'll treat your wounds the moment we're somewhere safe.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Ugh... piece of shit mayor. Lost his goddamn mind.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: He saw how many there were in that store, and set fire to it anyway. He doesn't even give a shit who lives or dies.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: I can tell why you've always made him out to be such a bastard.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Yeah, it's a whole house of bastards. Him and his mercenary goons.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: We all usually try to stay away from them, but somehow they still come calling.

spans.text: We all usually try to stay away from them, but

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: This way. Less people around.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: Hey, hey. Girlie. Hold it there. What's the rush?

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: Where's my allowance today? Huh? Got it on you?

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Eesh, seriously, friend... you pick some amazing times to ask me for money.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: The mayor's guys are coming this way. You sure you wanna be sitting there?

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: When you ain't got nothing, you ain't got nothing to lose.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: And that goes for the two of you, too. Whatcha so afraid of, scramming like hell?

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: You guys didn't start jack shit. So what's gotcha running out so far? Huh?

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Let's move, Ivy.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: *huff*—Finally home.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Ivy, let me take a look at your wounds.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: (Not deep, luckily. Quick ad-hoc treatment first, stop the bleeding.)

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Anywhere else you're hurt, apart from the leg?

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Mnn... I'm fine. Just catching my breath.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Freaking bastard... how can he exist?

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: I seriously hope someone teaches him a goddamn hard-ass lesson one day.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Hey, Dad! We're back!

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: I heard about the commotion. And then you two went missing at the exact same time... Had me stressed to high heaven.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: And how'd you get hurt, what happened? The heck did you two get up to?

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Mayor caught someone smuggling goods behind his back. Didn't just beat the tar out of them, set fire to their store too.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: We were in there at the time, then Ivy hurt herself on accident as we ran out.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: That mayor...

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: I warned you two not to head outdoors these days, didn't I? You gotta stay put at home.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: I just... wanted to buy Quartz a present.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: You know she's leaving soon.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: No talking back, just answer me—did I, or did I not tell you to stay put at home?

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Mrgh... yes, Dad, you did.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: So, tell me, was what you just did wrong of you?

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: ...Yes, it was.

steps.name: Aunt Pickett
steps.text: Enough! Ivy's hurt and all you want to do is chastise her!

spans.text: and all you want to do is chastise her!

steps.name: Aunt Pickett
steps.text: Come here, sweetie, and let me take a look at that injury.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Mom!

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: I'm okay, see! Besides, Quartz has been looking out for me the whole time.

steps.name: Aunt Pickett
steps.text: Is that right? Be sure you thank her properly, then. But don't forget to listen to your pa, too.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Thank you, Quartz.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: I should be apologizing, really. It's my fault you went out in the first place.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: I'm sorry, Uncle Pickett, for the trouble I've made.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: *sigh*... Forget it. We're lucky you were by her side. Who knows what could've happened to her otherwise.

steps.name: Aunt Pickett
steps.text: You know, you are leaving tomorrow, Quartz.

steps.name: Aunt Pickett
steps.text: What's your favorite food? I'll make it for you tonight.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Quartz... can't you just stay? I don't want you to go...

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Dad, couldn't we let Quartz stay at our place?

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: I know it's tomorrow, but just for even a day longer, please...?

a.text: If my father never left... if my mother never fell ill...
We would've been living our lives out together like this, as a family.
But I never got to make those memories, nor will I ever have the chance to make up for that.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: It's not like you'll never see me again, Ives. I'll come visit.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Uncle Pickett, thank you for your hospitality these past few days.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: I really should get going sooner than later, after bothering you for this long.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Hrmph. Don't thank me.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Fact of the matter is, I'm eager to get you out. Ivy's been sticking to you like glue, and I'm scared to find out what she's been learning.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: I'm amazed your parents would approve of you heading out alone into wilds as dangerous as ours.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: They, uh...

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: I imagine they would want to leave home and see the sights too, but... they've never had the chance.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: I know my father wouldn't approve. You're just like him, you know, always going on about how dangerous it is out there. Though I suppose he wasn't wrong.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: And you still went, knowing full well?

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Let me tell you, the people here—one second they're with those Liberi evangelists, wailing and gnashing and flogging themselves for all their past sins.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: But look away for one moment, and they'll cut your throat for a glass of beer, over a bet, for a single pet cystybeast.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: And lately, bandits have been raiding supply cars and Pioneer Teams right outside of town.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Our own mayor's a monster, and it's not like old Vincent at the precinct'll do anything for you.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Anything could happen here, and at any time. And when it does, there won't be a soul to help you, you understand?

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: So if you're done with your business, I say you hurry back on home.

a.text: I remember how I used to listen to my father jabber on like this, time after time.
It's an... indescribably familiar tone.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Enough. Couldn't tell you what time it is right now, but I know it's late.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: It's nine. The store across the street closes every night around then, and I just heard them moving stuff out of there.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Huh? Oh...

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Then get your belongings sorted pronto, and rest up. Meanwhile, I've got deliveries to run for that bastard... my rotten luck.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Stay safe tomorrow. Be home soon as you can.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Nine...

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: I guess I should be turning in about now. I always have.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: I don't want to sleep.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: But I don't know what else I feel like doing.

a.text: I don't know why, but everything that happened today is swirling through my brain like a tornado now.
Maybe I should do something or other.
*thud* *thud* *thud*!

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: (That's the sound of my father fixing the roof.)

steps.name: Father
steps.text: That ought to do it. And that means your mom can get a good night's sleep.

steps.name: Father
steps.text: Quartz! Quit it!

steps.name: Father
steps.text: Pay attention. Watch very carefully how I do things.

steps.name: Father
steps.text: You're going to have to do this stuff yourself someday, you know.

a.text: *thud* *thud* *thud*!

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: (That's the sound of thugs knocking at the door for repayment.)

steps.name: Father
steps.text: Get the hell out! Who let you into OUR house?!

steps.name: Father
steps.text: You know I'm going to pay back what I owe! But if you people DARE show up at our door like this again, I will NOT hesitate!

steps.name: Father
steps.text: See that, Quartz?

steps.name: Father
steps.text: It'll be your turn to protect your mom soon. So never, ever fear anybody.

steps.name: Father
steps.text: I won't be here to shield you guys forever, and like hell anyone else will help you. You gotta handle all this on your own.

a.text: *thud*! *thud*! *thud*!

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Shit! It's already so bright outside the window.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: How did I wake up so late today? I shouldn't have, I shouldn't...

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: I still have to... to...

a.text: *thud* *thud* *thud*!

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: (No, wait, that's the sound of someone knocking at the door.)

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Who is it?!

steps.name: Father?
steps.text: Quartz! Wake up! For the love of god, get up!

steps.name: Father?
steps.text: Take your belongings and run!

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Ivy, you and your mom stay in there for now and don't come out.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: The hell are you doing, crashing my house like this?!

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: (Mayor got jumped by someone last night. Steamed him so bad he sent out a search, leave no stone unturned and all. Won't calm down until we find the perp.)

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: (And you guys are the only ones who saw him last night.)

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: (Just work with me, okay? My hands are tied here...)

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: (He got attacked? Who has the balls to...)

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: When I knock, I want you to open! The hell are you yapping for?!

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Shit-for-brains, all of you!

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Gargh!

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Dad! Are you okay?!

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Get back in there.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: No! Why should I—

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Get back!

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Yeah, that's right, keep your girl in check. Don't make this any more complicated than it needs to be.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Nothing to hide, nothing to fear, okay, buddy?!

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Shit pisses me off, honestly. I'd rather kill the goddamn lot of you and THEN figure out if you did it.

steps.name: Aunt Pickett
steps.text: Ivy, listen to me. Go to your friend Quartz and stick with her.

steps.name: Aunt Pickett
steps.text: It'll all be fine. Don't worry.

a.text: I saw Ivy's face in that instant...
I was once like her. Unwilling, furious, but forced to swallow my anger.
Feeling pale and lost and praying for a miracle, or for some kind of hero. A million parts of you screaming, every last uncountable cell in you, but never getting an answer.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: I came back right after I was done with the mayor's deliveries. Didn't take a step outside after that.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: All the neighbors around can testify. We were all here at home.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: And it's just me, my wife, and these two girls here. How could we...

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Hey! Check this out!

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Guess what I found in the other room here?! This thing weighs a ton!

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Drop the weapon! Now!

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: The hell are you?!

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Easy there! Final warning!

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Is that... yours, Quartz?

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: You...

a.text: Ivy's eyes swim like hope when all is lost.
Maybe I've gotten rusty after not using a greatsword for so long, because it feels a little stiff in my hands.
But it's at home all the same.
I ready myself to face the enemy.
Yet out of the corner of my eye, I see someone pull Ivy from my side.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: (Dad?!)

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: (Quit pulling me! Quartz was...)

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: (If you want our family to stay out of trouble, then starting now, you shut your damn mouth.)

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: (I tell you this with every inch of solemnity: do not go near her.)

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: (Ugh! Dad!)

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Vincent, she was lodging at our place, nothing more.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: You wouldn't forget, would you? It was you who brought her to seek our help in the first place.

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: Uh... uh, yeah!

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: I was just thinking how pitiful she seemed at the time...

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: We only agreed on account of her seeming like just your regular lady. We didn't think anything more of it.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: So whoever she really is, we don't know a damn, and we sure as hell never asked.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: (Sorry, kid.)

a.text: Here I thought I'd find a part of my life I'd never had before.
Here I thought I could make up for my past regrets.
But that was just wishful thinking. It was all an illusion.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: They have nothing to do with this.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: I don't know them.

a.text: *thud*! *thud*! *thud*!

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: (That's the sound of my heart pounding.)

steps.name: Foreman
steps.text: See that? That's what happens when you rock the boat.

steps.name: Foreman
steps.text: If you have half a mind to keep working here, to keep making money...

steps.name: Foreman
steps.text: ...then don't ask unless you're told to ask, and don't mind unless you're told to mind.

steps.name: Foreman
steps.text: Understand?

a.text: *thud*... *thud*... *thud*...

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: (That's the sound of my mother's fading pulse.)

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Happy birthday, Mom!

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Look!

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: It's that present Dad promised he'd get you. I finally bought it!

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Mom...

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Son of a bitch!

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: Now, now... that's enough.

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: Look, she ain't moving anymore... Heaven knows if you just killed her...

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Tch... none of your goddamn business. Let's go to the mayor.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Watch her, old man. You know what happens if you let her run.

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: Miss? Miss?

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: Phew... Had me sweating there. Thought you'd done kicked the bucket for real.

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: You're... Quartz, right? My memory ain't what it used to be.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Yeah, it's Quartz.

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: I'll confess, I can get why you'd carry a weapon everywhere, seeing how dangerous it is out there alone.

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: But you sure walked into one hell of a mess...

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: *sigh* If you ask me, I know you didn't do it. If you're looking for someone who'd lay hands on that...

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: (...that bastard, there's plenty townsfolk who'd jump in line before an outsider like you ever got the chance.)

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: No matter what happens, no matter the consequences...

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: I can take it.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Not like I know where I should be going, anyway.

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: Anything? No matter the consequences? Easy for you to say, but what about your family, huh? Your parents? You think they could take it?

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: Look, I don't know where you're from, but worst case...

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: Just supposing there's, uh... a word or two I'd want to deliver your folks, I'd at least like to know who I'm looking for...

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: I'll be going to find them myself, soon enough.

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: What, you're gonna run after all? You can't cut me a break, can you?

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: You know how many people are out there? I don't think you can run.

spans.text: You know how many people are out there? I don't think you

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: *sigh*... Off the record, but... if you did manage to make off... I don't know whether I'd cry from fear or joy.

spans.text: *sigh*... Off the record, but... if you
manage to make off... I don't know whether I'd cry from fear or joy.

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: I mean, thinking about it... I know everyone's tearing into my ass these days.

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: But I've got a family too... and god help me, I know you didn't do it... but I'm just scared to contemplate... I'm sorry...

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: I bet Pickett's of the same mind... much as it's not my place to talk.

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: Really am.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: You done sermonizing there? 'Cause I'm sick of listening.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: One man spends all that breath t'say he knows the girl didn't do shit, and oh how he sympathizes, yet won't stick his neck out one inch.

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: Holy—?! How'd you get in?!

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: What's your business here?!

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: My business is with her, and not you.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: Need you to take a little nap though.

steps.name: Old Officer Vincent
steps.text: Ungh!

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: M'pologies, girlie.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: Didn't know I'd tow you into this, ah, hullabaloo. *sigh*...

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: How'd you get past everyone outside?

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: Outside? Hell, it's pure carnage outside right now, didn'tcha know?

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: Also, just before I let you go... you got any interest in joinin' us?

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Dad, what the hell is the mayor calling everyone here for?

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: What's he gonna do?!

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: The two of you, stay with me. Don't get lost.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: I don't get it. Why is everyone so afraid of him?

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: We've got the numbers, look at us. Can't we just drive him out of town?!

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Ivy, your dad is going to beg you here.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Yes, in fact, I am BEGGING you!

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: LISTEN to me, okay? I don't want nothing bad happening to you.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Long as we're together as a family, we'll be fine.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Just... trust your dad, okay?

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Just catching the perp won't be enough. If there's even one person willing to try their luck, then I guarantee you there will be a second.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Just goes to show I've been too easy on them. They've begun to get wicked thoughts, and I won't let that stand.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: And so what if we catch them, anyway? This whole chase ain't healing my wounds, or staying my rage.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: What do you want us to do?

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Round up the families you've investigated, plus the two merchants who thought importing behind my back was a smart idea...

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Get them all locked up. Whoever doesn't behave, throw them in a Pioneer Team.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: But keep one from every family in the town. That way, no one will try to take the chance to run.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Squeeze them where it hurts, and they'll listen.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: On it...

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Dad!

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: You sons of bitches! What is this?!

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: We're not even Infected! The hell are we going to Pioneer Teams for?!

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Either you stay in town and your wife and daughter get sent, or your daughter stays and you and your wife are brand new Pioneers.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Am I clear?!

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Dad...

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Can I... go to the Pioneers myself?

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Let my wife and girl stay, I beg of you.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: This ain't open for discussion.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Only one of you stays in town!

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: You—! You assholes! This is too far!

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: They found you while you were casing the place, so you just walloped the mayor right there?

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: You're roving bandits, right? The raids outside of town these days, that's all you. You're eyeing the town itself now?

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: Bandits, fugitives, criminals... call us whatever you like.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: We're just a buncha regular folk at the end of our ropes.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: And we're not eyeing the town. We're eyeing the mayor, and every one of his kind.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: And what about the rest of the townsfolk?

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Pull something this loud, and you'll drag a whole mess of people in, including the innocent.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: *sigh*... Listen to you, a bundle of nerves like all the rest.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: We're just lookin' to hold the guys at the top accountable. Not like we're tryin' to be heroes of justice or whatnot.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: These people are weak. They're cowardly. They don't give a damn.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: They get what's comin' to them.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: Doubtin', worryin', fearin', mindin' what they do so much, they may as well do the safest thing—which is nothin' at all.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: And that makes the most obedient kinda person, don'tcha see? They got doubts. They never dare. That's why everyone here fears the mayor.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: But I don't. I'm an old panhandler with no job, no home. What do I fear?

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: He yaps my ear off, no shit I'll beat the daylights outta him.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: Maybe he woulda killed me, but like hell he could take me, so I beat him to kingdom come. Damn shame he got away.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: And here he is now, takin' it out on these folks because he couldn't face up to me any day of the week.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: Makes all kinds of sense, wouldn'tcha say?

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: You can't get a damn thing done for how you stick fast to the rules. And them? They live like there's no law, and their reward is kickin' their feet up on top of your heads.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: So hell, what's the problem? What's to fear?

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: Sure you'll be 'bad,' but what's that even matter?

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: You really don't talk like a panhandler.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: But a panhandler I've been made to be, and I'll let you know you've become quite a vagabond yourself.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: So say I choose not to join you?

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: You can leave anytime, carry on your journey. I won't force you, that much is granted.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: I'll see you on your way. Get goin'.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Ivy! What the hell?!

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Drop that goddamn weapon! You're going to hurt yourself!

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Miss, you'd best listen to your pap.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Don't be in a rush to get yourself hurt. Think of your mom and pap—just think of them.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Good. Think. You try and take us, and what do you think'll happen to them?

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: No one here wants to see anything gruesome.

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Ivy, don't do anything stupid!

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: So long as we're a family, we can get through anything together.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: But we're not gonna be, are we? We're not gonna be together.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Doesn't matter who goes to the Pioneers and who stays in town, we're getting split up.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: And who the hell knows what happens after that?

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: I can see where this is going, and it's nowhere good.

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: So, what's the worst that could happen? You guys gonna kill me?

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Alright! Say I die, Dad, are you gonna take revenge for me? Or are you gonna keep wrangling with yourself?

steps.name: Uncle Pickett
steps.text: Ivy! What is this nonsense you're cooking?!

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Weren't you guys gonna take me?!

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: C'mon, then! C'MON!

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Shit!

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Your time's up, kid!

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Quartz?!

steps.name: Ivy
steps.text: Wha—?!

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: You little shit! How'd you get out?!

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Where the hell is that Vincent SOB?! Did he make his peace or something?!

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Don't bother going. I plan to cut you all down.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: And then I'll drag that bastard mayor out too!

steps.name: Mercenary A & Mercenary B
steps.text: Argh!

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: Whatcha got there?

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: ...That's that girl, ain't it. The one you felt was like a kid sister.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Ivy's a brave girl. And Uncle Pickett, and Auntie. None of them are bad people.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: I want to deny it so badly, but if years and years ago, I were in their place, I might've done the same as them.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: I hurt my own father out of fear of someone's wrath.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Bent over time's knee, strived to work, out of fear I couldn't pay for my mother's treatments.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Didn't even know where I went wrong until I lost it all. After doing everything they asked me to do, everything right.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: I began to regret, to despair, and even to blame those who put doubt in my mind. Felt like if it wasn't for them, I'd have been brave enough to choose differently.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: And now you have the chance to make up for lost time, with us.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: The lot you have ain't your fault. Never was.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: No. It was.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Suddenly I understood, when I saw Ivy.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: I could've chosen completely differently. I've been doing nothing but making excuses. Excuses for my past timidity and weakness.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: I see how... precious a thing it is, having someone who worries for you.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Like Uncle Pickett does for his beloved daughter, and old Vincent does for his little granddaughter.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: It's a cowardly disgrace, but anything but lamentable.

steps.name: Old Panhandler
steps.text: You gonna go help her then? That's a lotta mercs. You ready for that?

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: Did you forget, friend?

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: I'm just like you, one lone person.

steps.name: Quartz
steps.text: What am I scared of? I'll put it all on the line!

a.text: Do what you want to do. Never again regret what's gone by. Never again fear what's yet to pass... I may not know where my next destination is—
But I know where I should be going.
